dialogues.speaker: Lipalli
dialogues.text: An easy-breezy Natlan in an easy-breezy summer! Welcome to Colorfall Cliffs! Want to give our Chromatic Spirals in the Sky challenge a try?

dialogues.speaker: Lipalli
dialogues.text: If you're interested, you can start from the hot air balloon platform over there.

dialogues.speaker: Lipalli
dialogues.text: You completed the challenge, and you did a darn good job... Whew, it brings a tear to my eye.
